body:
## Why
Nothing runs `hkb gc` automatically, so a day of dispatching left 22 `worktree-kb-*` branches and their worktrees on the host (user report, screenshot of 2026-08-26). Cleanup must be part of the loop, not a chore.

## What
- Factor the sweeps in `src/gc.js` (worktrees of closed/done tasks + their branches, orphaned `worktree-kb-*` branches already merged into the default branch, duplicate run comments, old logs/nudges) into callable functions.
- The tick runs a cheap incremental pass: whenever reconcile/reap sees a task leave the open board, remove that task's worktrees and branches on this host right then (never an open attempt's).
- A full sweep runs every `dispatch.gc_every_ticks` (default 30) — same code `hkb gc --yes` calls, so manual and automatic can never diverge.
- Removal failures (locked by a live session) are skipped silently and retried next pass; a live session's lock pid is respected as today.

## Done when
After a task merges, its worktree and branch are gone from the host within a tick or two, `git branch` stays bounded during a long dispatch run, and `hkb gc --yes` still works standalone.
title: The dispatcher cleans up after itself: auto-gc of worktrees, branches and finished agents
